comment: Single source of the git-config and remote floors (round 41). floors.ts reads this file at module load and test/gate-floors.test.ts reads the same file. keyPatterns: lower-case regular expressions over a git config key; a write of a matching key (git config, -c, --config-env) is a floor deny in every session kind. It is the union of scripts/git_guard.py CHILD_CONFIG_DENY and the plan's Addendum B list (url.*.insteadOf, url.*.pushInsteadOf, branch.*.pushRemote, remote.pushDefault, remote.*.push, remote.*.url, remote.*.pushurl, core.hooksPath, core.sshCommand, credential.*, include.path, includeIf.*, protocol.*.allow). remoteSubcommands: git remote subcommands that change remotes (git_guard.py CHILD_REMOTE_DENY). envPattern: environment words that inject git config. protectedBranches: the branch names that are always protected, beside safety.git.protectedBranches and the remote HEAD.
